Perfect! You're now in the `yolov5c` directory. You can now run your training command:

```bash
python train.py --data ../Regurgitation-YOLODataset-Detection/data.yaml --cfg models/yolov5sc.yaml --hyp data/hyps/hyp.custom.yaml --epochs 10 --batch-size 8 --img 416
```

This command will:
- Use the regurgitation dataset from `../Regurgitation-YOLODataset-Detection/data.yaml`
- Use the YOLOv5 small classification model configuration (`models/yolov5sc.yaml`)
- Apply custom hyperparameters optimized for multi-task learning (`data/hyps/hyp.custom.yaml`)
- Train for 10 epochs
- Use a batch size of 8
- Use an image size of 416x416 pixels

The training will start and you should see output showing the model initialization, dataset loading, and training progress.
